## Performance Leaderboard

Recognize and celebrate top performers across various metrics. Our leaderboard showcases individuals and teams who demonstrate excellence in analytics, data quality, innovation, and collaboration.

Rankings are updated monthly based on a comprehensive scoring system that evaluates multiple performance dimensions.

## Top Performers

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

set.seed(789)

# Create sample leaderboard data
leaderboard_data <- data.frame(
  Rank = 1:20,
  User = c("Sarah Johnson", "Michael Chen", "Amanda Wilson", "Daniel White",
           "Emily Rodriguez", "Robert Taylor", "Jessica Martinez", "David Kim",
           "James Brown", "Maria Garcia", "Christopher Lee", "Nicole Anderson",
           "Alex Thompson", "Rachel Kim", "Steven Park", "Laura Martinez",
           "Kevin Wong", "Diana Chen", "Brandon Lee", "Sophia Rodriguez"),
  Department = sample(c("Analytics", "Data Science", "Engineering"), 20, replace = TRUE),
  Total_Points = c(9850, 9420, 9180, 8965, 8734, 8590, 8412, 8289,
                   8156, 7998, 7845, 7723, 7612, 7498, 7356, 7234,
                   7145, 7012, 6898, 6756),
  Projects_Completed = sample(15:45, 20, replace = TRUE),
  Quality_Score = round(runif(20, 85, 99.5), 1),
  Innovation_Score = sample(70:100, 20, replace = TRUE),
  Collaboration_Score = sample(75:100, 20, replace = TRUE)
) %>%
  arrange(Rank) %>%
  mutate(
    Overall_Rating = round((Quality_Score + Innovation_Score + Collaboration_Score) / 3, 1),
    Badge = case_when(
      Rank <= 3 ~ "🥇 Elite",
      Rank <= 10 ~ "⭐ Top Performer",
      Rank <= 15 ~ "💎 High Achiever",
      TRUE ~ "✨ Rising Star"
    ),
    Points_From_First = Total_Points - max(Total_Points)
  )

# Create interactive table
datatable(leaderboard_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 20,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
            order = list(list(0, 'asc'))
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Monthly Performance Leaderboard") %>%
  formatStyle('Rank',
              target = 'row',
              backgroundColor = styleInterval(
                c(3, 10),
                c('#ffd700', '#e8f4f8', 'white')
              )) %>%
  formatStyle('Overall_Rating',
              background = styleColorBar(c(0, 100), '#667eea'),
              backgroundSize = '95% 75%',
              backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat',
              backgroundPosition = 'center') %>%
  formatRound(c('Quality_Score', 'Overall_Rating'), 1) %>%
  formatStyle('Badge',
              fontWeight = 'bold')
```

## Leaderboard Categories

The performance score is calculated based on:

- **Projects Completed** (30%): Number and complexity of completed projects
- **Quality Score** (30%): Code quality, documentation, and peer reviews
- **Innovation Score** (20%): Novel approaches and creative solutions
- **Collaboration Score** (20%): Teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mentoring

Congratulations to all our top performers! 🎉
